lines.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High abides in the Almighty's shadow, and the writer calls the LORD his refuge.
Though a thousand fall at your side, you will witness the rescue of the wicked.
God will command His prophets to guard you, and you will tread on the lion and cobra.
The LORD will deliver and protect the one who loves Him, be with him in trouble, and show him salvation.
